$comment: Shared definitions for the Curriculum Pack schemas. Spec 03 §2.1 (packs are plain JSON validated by packs/schema/pack.schema.json) and §2.3 (semantic versioning, override paths); scalar formats follow spec 02 §1.2 (calendar dates are YYYY-MM-DD).
title: Curriculum pack shared definitions
description: Reusable scalar and list shapes referenced by every other pack schema.

packCode.description: Pack identifier such as ke-cbe, ke-844 or cambridge-intl (spec 03 §2.1). Lowercase segments separated by single hyphens.

code.description: A pack-local code for a level, stage, pathway, learning area, slot, competency or band. Packs reference entities by code, never by database row id (spec 03 §2.1, §3).

name.description: Human-readable display name. Labels themselves live in the pack locale files (spec 03 §2.1, §8.2).

date.description: Calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the institution time zone (spec 02 §1.2). The pattern checks shape only; a runtime check rejects impossible dates.

semver.description: Semantic version. Major is a structural change, minor adds options or templates, patch fixes labels or comments (spec 03 §2.3).

packRef.description: A pinned pack reference of the form pack_code@version, as used by a programme (spec 03 §2.3, example ke-cbc@2024.2.0).

semverRange.description: A semver requirement string, for example >=1.0.0 (spec 03 §2.2 requires_engine).

localeTag.description: BCP 47 style language tag such as en, sw, fr, pt or ar (spec 03 §8.2).

weight.description: A share of a whole expressed as a fraction from 0 to 1. Weights for one computation must sum to 1; JSON Schema cannot sum an array or map, so that is a documented runtime check.

precision.description: Number of decimal places kept at a computation stage (spec 03 §4 rounding, §6 aggregation precision).

codeList.description: A non-empty list of pack-local codes with no repeats.

overridePath.description: A dotted path into pack data that a school may override, with * as a wildcard, for example grading_scales.kcse_subject.bands or reports.*.branding (spec 03 §2.3).
